Package application

Class StaffHomePage

java.lang.Object
application.StaffHomePage
public class StaffHomePage extends Object
StaffHomePage provides the interface for staff members to review and monitor interactions within the Qinvalid input: '&A' system. Staff members can assess questions, answers, and private feedback to help identify potential issues early.
Version:
1.0
Author:
